name: Lustworth Academy
source:
The story follows juvenile delinquent Jimmy Napkins, a young outcast who’s been expelled from every school he’s ever attended. If Jimmy can survive his last school year and outsmart his new rivals, he could rule the entire town. Take control of Jimmy in this graphic adventure full of sex, bad jokes, and wacky stories. Stand up to bullies, get picked on by teachers, play pranks, win or lose the girls, and ultimately learn to navigate the obstacles of the worst prep school around, Lustworth Academy, while avoiding being sent to the military school for good.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/impactxplay]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕少年犯吉米·纳普金斯 (Jimmy Napkins) 展开，他是一个被逐出的年轻男孩，曾被他上过的每一所学校开除。如果吉米能熬过最后一个学年并智胜他的新对手，他就可以统治整个小镇。在这场充满性、糟糕笑话和古怪故事的图形冒险中控制吉米。勇敢地面对欺凌，被老师欺负，恶作剧，赢得或失去女孩，并最终学会克服周围最糟糕的预科学校拉斯特沃斯学院的障碍，同时避免被永远送到军校。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/impactxplay]Patreon[/url]]
